inclusion_rules: The member action is inside the declared House, Congress, session, date, and service boundary.
The exact action has an official House Clerk identity and resolved member action.
The exact action is substantive rather than procedural or expressive nonbinding context.
Official exact-action evidence establishes material Justice/Public Safety content; parent-measure context alone is insufficient.
A FISA action may be Justice cross-domain only where its exact scope materially governs surveillance, FISC or court process, or civil liberties, while National Security membership is retained.
Present or Not Voting actions may remain in the universe as non-directional records; they do not become support or opposition evidence.
exclusion_rules: Keyword recall alone cannot establish Justice membership.
Parent-measure or rule context cannot establish the issue eligibility of a narrower exact action.
Procedural controls remain context-only and non-counting.
Expressive nonbinding actions remain visible but non-substantive and never enter synthesis.
Actions assigned by official metadata to another policy area are excluded unless exact-action evidence establishes reviewed cross-domain membership.
